maintenanceTab.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintenanceTab.intro: Shows a banner to every signed-in user, on every page, until you turn it off. Turn it on before planned work that interrupts queries — replacing the engine cluster, switching its topology, or upgrading the control plane — so the interruption reads as scheduled rather than broken.
maintenanceTab.messageHint: Leave empty for the standard wording.
maintenanceTab.endsAtHint: Leave empty to say no estimate is being offered rather than to imply one.
maintenanceTab.dangerIntro: Stops the backend and the UI dev server on this machine. Only works against a --demo/--native desktop launch — refused everywhere else.
maintenanceTab.stopConfirm: Kill the backend and UI dev server on this machine? This ends your session immediately.
